name: Límite de Mezcla Facial
description: Detecta límites de mezcla facial en videos deepfake
algorithm: Face Blend Boundary — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method detects face blending boundaries for deepfake detection:

1. **Mezcla Límite Localization**: The boundary where a generated/swapped face meets the original video is detected. This is typically an oval or irregular contour around the face where alpha blending, Poisson blending, or feathered compositing was applied. The boundary is localized using gradient analysis and texture transition detection.

2. **Límite Gradiente Análisis**: At the blending boundary, the method measures gradient profiles perpendicular to the boundary. Natural skin-to-hair/neck transitions show anatomically motivated gradients. Artificial blending creates characteristic smooth transition zones with unnatural gradient profiles — too uniform or too symmetrical compared to natural boundaries.

3. **Color Discontinuity Detección**: Even with sophisticated blending (Poisson editing), subtle color discontinuities persist at the boundary. The method detects these by analyzing color channel differences across the boundary in multiple color spaces (RGB, Lab, YCbCr). The CIE ΔE color difference is computed across the boundary.

4. **Textura Frecuencia Mismatch**: The spatial frequency content (texture) on either side of the blending boundary is compared. Generated face texture (inside the boundary) often differs from original footage texture (outside) — different noise characteristics, sharpness, or compression artifacts. This frequency mismatch is detectable even when color blending is well-executed.

5. **Temporal Límite Estabilidad**: The blending boundary position and width should remain consistent relative to the face across frames. The method tracks boundary characteristics over time — unstable or shifting boundary artifacts indicate per-frame independent face generation with inconsistent blending, yielding elevated forensic scores.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante face blend boundary analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
